notes: τοὺς πεποιθότας is treated under rule 31 rather than rule 90, τινας being the expressed head the article governs, so the relativizer rides with the participle.

τοὺς λοιπούς → *all others* gives *all* to the article under rules 49 and 102 and *others* to the adjective; no other source token competes for the determiner slot, and the note names the alternative that reads *all* as supplied.
